record.original_question: Let F be a non-abelian free pro-p group of finite rank. Can one find a finite collection U1,..., Un of open subgroups of F including F itself such that the only subgroup of F which is contained in Ui and is characteristic in Ui for every i is the trivial subgroup?

evidence.quote: Let F be a non-abelian free pro-p group of finite rank. Can one find a finite collection U1,..., Un of open subgroups of F including F itself such that the only subgroup of F which is contained in Ui and is characteristic in Ui for every i is the trivial subgroup?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a prime and let $F$ be a non-abelian free pro-$p$ group of finite rank (i.e., the free pro-$p$ group on a finite set of $\geq 2$ generators in the category of pro-$p$ groups). A subgroup $H \leq U$ of a topological group $U$ is called characteristic in $U$ if $\varphi(H) = H$ for every continuous automorphism $\varphi$ of $U$.

Question: Does there exist a finite collection $U_1, U_2, \dots, U_n$ of open subgroups of $F$, with $F$ itself among them, such that the only (closed) subgroup $H$ of $F$ with the property
$$H \subseteq U_i \quad \text{and} \quad H \text{ is characteristic in } U_i \text{ for every } i = 1, \dots, n$$
is the trivial subgroup $\{1\}$?
